items.text: Add sound: cards without sentence audio get their own line's sound, with one press and one Undo.
The AI voice (beta) reads cards with no real sound. Needs you's Set it up guides you through it.
Episodes already mined get their new words: by themselves, or with Mine the new words on ⋯.
The window opens at once at your last screen, even right after an update.
The green card number counts the cards still left to study (✓ when none are left).
⇄ and Add now work on every subtitle line; without its video, the swap waits in Needs you.
Words: a set phrase inside a longer one counts too (いい加減, にしても, 気が付く).
Words: a plain-kana つかれた is 疲れる, be tired, no longer 突く.
Quitting right after an update no longer leaves a background worker running.
The pitch accent sits on its kana at every size.
A show's songs are left out of the rarity numbers too, as they are of your list.
A hato episode with no show joins the show whose videos sit beside it.
Settings' level numbers update by themselves after a sync, a mark or a Generate.
Anki Miner starts once, not three times, when Settings › Anki & mining opens.
